reference_count_semantics: Manifest group-based counts count distinct retained Markdown documents naming the artifact group, not exact per-member hyperlinks. Exact package-file counts and legacy-group counts state their own basis. Markdown parser covers inline [label](target) links; code-fence/inline plain paths are reported as group mentions. Existing already-missing paths excluded from newly broken count.
critical_claim_policy: Final JSON/CKPT1/readiness retained tracked; R14 W1-W7, canonical ledgers, STOP/config/source retained. Historical raw replay loss acknowledged; no ACTIVE production dependency.
